If $D\sim N(\mu_D,\sigma_D^2)$ with $\sigma_D>0$, the exact central 95% quantiles for individual differences are $\mu_D\pm z_{.975}\sigma_D$, where $z_{.975}=\Phi^{-1}(.975)$; $1.96$ is the customary rounded approximation. If $\sigma_D=0$, both quantiles equal $\mu_D$ and their singleton interval has probability one. These limits are not a 95% confidence interval for either endpoint.
